2026-10-24.title: Tokyo to Kanazawa
notes: Backup if Sho Sushi is full: Morimori Sushi (Forus 6F, by Kanazawa Station, open to 21:30, walk-in).

stops.notes: Visit Japan Web QR codes ready. Get Suica, or set up mobile Suica beforehand. Paid shower rooms in T3.

stops.what: Keikyu to Shinagawa, JR to Tokyo Station
stops.notes: Board toward Shinagawa/Sengakuji, not Yokohama. Then JR Yamanote or Keihin-Tohoku northbound.
Large coin lockers are free this early. ecbo cloak as backup.

stops.what: Toei Mita line, Otemachi to Jimbocho
stops.notes: 1 stop.
The original, 3-16 Kanda-Nishikicho. Weekends 09:00 to 19:00. Arrive early to beat the Saturday queue.
stops.map: Glitch Coffee & Roasters, 3-16 Kanda Nishikicho, Chiyoda, Tokyo

stops.notes: Most open 10:00 to 11:00.
Jimbocho main branch, 2F Kanda Kosho Center Bldg, 2-3-3 Kanda Jimbocho. Sat opens 10:00. Beef curry and baked pudding. Queues build by noon.
About 20 min walk via Takebashi. Free, open Saturday. Exit via Otemon.

stops.what: Tokyo Station: collect bags, buy ekiben
stops.notes: About 10 min walk. Ekibenya Matsuri, central concourse.
Kagayaki 511 leaves 16:24. Sleep.
1-8-24 Katamachi, Hokuriku Saikawa Bldg 1F. 8-seat omakase counter: sea urchin and nodoguro hand roll. Taxi about 10 min from the station. Reserve.

2026-10-25.title: Castle, Kenroku-en and the museum quarter
2026-10-25.route: All walking, about 3 km: Curio, Oyama Shrine, Kanazawa Castle, Kenroku-en, 21st Century Museum, D.T. Suzuki Museum, dinner.
notes: Miyuki and Itaru are closed Sundays.

stops.notes: Yasuecho. Sun 08:00 to 15:00. Breakfast sandwich. Arrive at opening.
stops.map: Curio Espresso and Vintage Design, Kanazawa

stops.notes: 10 min walk. Stained-glass gate.

stops.what: Kanazawa Castle Park and Gyokusen-inmaru Garden
stops.notes: In via Nezumitamon, out via Ishikawa-mon.
Cross the bridge, enter by Katsurazaka gate. Beat the tour buses.
Inside Kenroku-en. Matcha and wagashi with a garden view. About 40 min with the wait.
At the garden. Jibuni set about ¥3,000. Ask for a window seat.
Leave Kenroku-en by Mayumizaka gate, 3 min. Swimming Pool slot booked online that morning. Closed Mon.
stops.map: 21st Century Museum of Contemporary Art, Kanazawa

stops.notes: 10 min walk via Honda-machi. Closes 17:00. Closed Mon.
Takaokamachi. Sun 17:00 to 20:30. 10-piece omakase about ¥3,000. Tiny counter: call ahead.

2026-10-26.title: Omicho, Nagamachi, Nishi Chaya and Teramachi
2026-10-26.route: North to south: Omicho, townsfolk, Nagamachi, Korinbo, Sai River bridge, Teramachi and Nishi Chaya, back across the bridge to dinner.

stops.notes: Omicho Market. Mon 07:00 to 13:30. Kaisendon about ¥2,500. Write your order on the sheet at the door. Cash only.
22-18 Takaokamachi. Light roast, Copenhagen style. On the way to Nagamachi.
Nomura-ke (08:30 to 17:30), Onosho canal lanes, Nagamachi Yuzen-kan.
One-man udon shop, ¥630 to ¥950. Cash only.

stops.what: Walk south via Korinbo, cross the Sai River
stops.notes: About 20 min.
Guided tour only. Reserve by phone.
Nishi Chaya. Grill-your-own mochi zenzai ¥880.
Small, 30 min.
Kutani-yaki. Closes 17:00.
3-8 Kakinokibatake, about 15 min walk back across the bridge. Opens 17:30. Kaga set about ¥8,800. Reserve. Not the Itaru nodoguro lunch shop next door.

2026-10-27.title: Shirakawa-go, then Higashiyama
2026-10-27.route: Shirakawa-go bus, Kanazawa Station, bus to Hashiba-cho, Higashiyama on foot, Owaricho dinner (10 min walk).
notes: Walk-in dinner backup: Higashiyama Torihada (yakitori and hot pot, Tue 17:00 to 21:00).

stops.notes: 2-6-2-3 Higashiyama. Tue only 12:00 to 16:00. Pour-over in a wine glass. Go first.
stops.warn: Your Shirakawa-go tour is booked until 17:00, and this closes at 16:00. Confirm the return time.

stops.notes: Shima or Kaikaro teahouse, gold leaf shops. Shops close 17:00 to 18:00.
Higashi branch. 400-year-old confectioner. 09:00 to 18:00.
Optional, 5 min uphill.

stops.what: Kazue-machi and the Asano River at dusk
stops.notes: Lantern-lit geisha street.
Owaricho. Tue 17:00 to 23:00. Wagyu, pressed sushi, pear sorbet. Reserve.

stops.map: Curio Espresso and Vintage Design, Kanazawa

stops.notes: Some Omicho stalls close Wednesdays. Museums open again.

stops.what: Check out; takkyubin bags to the Osaka hotel
stops.notes: Hand bags to the front desk. They arrive the next day. Travel with a daypack.
Forus 6F, by Kanazawa Station. Opens 11:00. Premium kaiten, torched nodoguro. Go early.

stops.what: Hokuriku Shinkansen to Tsuruga, Thunderbird to Osaka
stops.notes: About 2.5 hours with the transfer. Reserved seats on both legs.
USJ tomorrow: early night.

Namba 1-7-15, Edoyasu Bldg B1F, behind Shochikuza. 17:00 to 23:00 (L.O. 22:00), open daily. 15 seats, no reservations: arrive near opening. Smoking allowed. About ¥3,000 to ¥4,000. Buta-tama and yakisoba.
About an hour before opening. JR to Universal City. Halloween season: expect crowds.
stops.warn: Your USJ booking in the app starts at 13:00. Check the entry time on the voucher.

stops.what: Dinner at Universal CityWalk or near the hotel
stops.label: Evening
stops.notes: Early night.

2026-10-30.title: Kitahama, Tennoji, teamLab at night
2026-10-30.route: Kitahama and Nakanoshima on foot, Sakaisuji line Kitahama to Ebisucho (about 10 min), Shinsekai, Shitennoji, Tennoji Park, Abeno Harukas, Midosuji line Tennoji to Nagai (3 stops).

stops.notes: Kitahama, 1-5-7 Awajimachi. Weekdays 09:00 to 17:00.

stops.what: Nakanoshima Rose Garden and Central Public Hall
stops.notes: Free.
1912 building, British tea room. Opens 11:00 weekdays. Light lunch.
Jan Jan Yokocho. 30 min past Tsutenkaku.
15 min walk. Closes 16:00.
Right behind the temple. Matcha cheesecake.
Tennoji Park. ¥300. 09:30 to 17:00.
09:00 to 22:00. Open-air roof terrace. Sunset about 17:10.

stops.warn: Your teamLab booking in the app is 18:00, but this plan has you there at 19:00. Check the entry time on the ticket.

stops.notes: Nagai Station exit 3, 10 min walk. 18:00 to 22:30, last entry 21:30.

2026-10-31.title: Day trip: Himeji and Kobe
2026-10-31.route: JR Special Rapid Osaka to Himeji (about 60 min), Himeji on foot, JR to Sannomiya (about 40 min), Kitano uphill (about 15 min), JR back to Osaka (about 25 min). Out of Osaka on Halloween night.
notes: Alternative Kobe beef: Kobe Beef Amami (daily 11:00 to 23:00).

stops.notes: IC card OK.
Arrive at opening; Saturday crowds build fast.
Next to the castle.
40 Sakatamachi, about 10 min from the castle. Opens 10:30. 90-minute seat limit.
88 Junishomae-cho, about 10 min from the station. Lunch 11:00 to 14:00. Grilled conger eel. Queue likely.
Foreign merchant houses. Weathercock House 09:00 to 17:00, ¥500. Uphill from Sannomiya.
Sankita St, 1-9-4 Kitanagasadori. Daily 10:30 to 23:00. Upgrade to garlic fried rice. Reserve.

2026-11-01.title: Shopping: Horie, Amemura, Shinsaibashi
2026-11-01.route: All walking: Kitahorie, Shinmachi, Orange Street, Dotonbori, Amemura, Shinsaibashi-suji, Dotonbori at night. Most shops open 11:00 to 12:00.

stops.notes: Kitahorie. Daily 08:30 to 21:00. French toast, egg sandwich.
Shinmachi. Sun opens 11:00. Takeaway only.
Independent fashion and homeware.
Dotonbori. Daily 11:00 to 21:00. Try the yamaimo-yaki. Order while queuing.
Edge of Amemura. Daily 11:00 to 23:00.
Fashion, cosmetics, Don Quijote.

stops.what: Dotonbori at night, dinner to decide
stops.label: Evening

2026-11-02.title: Day trip: Nara
2026-11-02.route: Kintetsu Namba to Kintetsu Nara (about 40 min), Chami, Todai-ji, Wakakusayama, Kasuga Taisha, Naramachi, all walking, Kintetsu back.

stops.notes: IC card OK.
Near Nara Park. Daily 07:30 to 19:00.
Great Buddha Hall.
Forest trail on the back side.
Lantern-lined shrine.
Hiraso (kakinoha-zushi) is closed Mondays.
Akahada-yaki pottery, sumi ink.
Naramachi, 5 Tsubaicho. Pour-over only, in an alley. Mon 09:30 to 18:00.
Dinner in Osaka to decide.

2026-11-03.title: Kita coffee day (Culture Day holiday)
2026-11-03.route: Walking: Kyomachibori, Utsubo Park, Edobori, Nakanoshima, Umeda, Nakazakicho, Tenjinbashisuji, Tenma. Pick 2 of the 3 roasters.
notes: Izakaya Toyo is closed on public holidays.

stops.notes: Kyomachibori. Daily 08:00 to 18:00.
Next door.
Edobori. Opens 11:00. Homemade doughnuts.
Festival Tower West 1F, Nakanoshima.
stops.map: Glitch Coffee Osaka, Festival Tower West

stops.notes: Grand Front, LUCUA, Hankyu.
Old alleys, vintage, cafés. Yatt Nakazakicho café (10:00 to 20:00, scones and pudding).
Longest covered shopping street in Japan. Walk south toward Tenma.
Walk-in alleys around JR Tenma station. Harukoma sushi is closed Tuesdays.

2026-11-04.title: Fushimi Inari at dawn, Izakaya Toyo
2026-11-04.route: Keihan line to Fushimi-Inari, summit loop on foot, Keihan back to Kyobashi (same line), Toyo, JR to Umeda (10 min).

stops.notes: About 50 min.

stops.what: Fushimi Inari Taisha, full summit loop
stops.notes: About 2.5 to 3 hours. Upper gates nearly empty this early.
3-2-26 Higashinodamachi, 1 min from JR Kyobashi. Opens 13:00, L.O. 18:30. Cash only, no reservations. Seared tuna cheek, uni, fatty tuna.

stops.what: Rest, pack, or final Umeda shopping
stops.notes: Glitch Osaka open weekdays 08:00 to 19:00 if skipped yesterday.

stops.label: Evening
